text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the adoption of a by-law to designate an accessible parking space on the north side of Glory Crescent where currently parking is permitted for a maximum period of three hours.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible parking space to operate at all times on the north side of Glory Crescent, between a point 54 metres east of Celeste Drive (north intersection) and a point 6 metres further east.
